{{Quote|Sounds like a legend. Maybe a hoax.''"<br />"''Perhaps. However, an intrusion was reported three years ago in the Gardaji region, from an unknown space-faring species. It was that which Vergere was sent to investigate, and incidentally, to see if she could locate Zonama Sekot. She found the planet&hellip; and sent to our farthest outlying station a brief message. But nothing has been heard of her since.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="RP" />}}
The '''Gardaji sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and was in the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Gardaji Rift/Legends|Gardaji Rift]] and was the original location of [[Sentience/Legends|living]] free-floating [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]].
